title: Stanzas, Lines, and Rhyme Schemes
skills: identify lines and stanzas in poems
analyze how stanza structure organizes poetic ideas
explain how line and rhyme patterns contribute to form and meaning
alignment_note: Introduces the structural building blocks of poetry, including lines, stanzas, and rhyme schemes. Supports recognition of poetic form, analysis of organization and sound patterns, and interpretation of how structural choices contribute to meaning across high school English courses.
